items.question: Are the iron sacrifice, gold sacrifice, recitation, and brahmakhaṇḍana included among occasions granting the fruit of all sacrifices?
premises: The preceding verses assert attainment of the fruit of all sacrifices without doubt.
The iron sacrifice and gold sacrifice are enumerated as ritual occasions.
Recitation and brahmakhaṇḍana are listed alongside these sacrifices.
items.inference: These additional rites and acts are included among occasions that confer the complete fruit of all sacrifices.
uncertainties: The precise sense of brahmakhaṇḍane, whether a textual section or an act of breaking, is unclear.
The specific ritual meaning of pāṭane in this list is not fully determined.
items.plain_english: In the iron sacrifice, in the gold sacrifice, in recitation, and in the brahmakhaṇḍana.
